cases.summary: Export was created with Elementor 4.1.3; V4 Atomic, Classes, Variables, Components and Interactions experiments are present; site-settings reports classesCount=1 and variablesCount=0.
Home2 root uses a grid container with width=100vw, min_height=100vh, 2fr columns, custom rows 0.5fr 1fr, and a cover background image.
Three empty e-flexbox elements are not pure spacers; they are visual placeholder panels with width=33.33vw, height=56vh, background #b2b2b2, radius=8px.
Two CTA buttons repeat nearly the same local-class style with fixed 250px × 70px dimensions and different colors/margins.
Solutions contains 28 desktop absolute-positioned styled elements, mainly overlay icons/text in repeated card patterns.
Solutions cards use 25% desktop width, 100% mobile width, relative parents and absolute overlay SVGs; pattern is valid for decorative overlays but fragile for content.
Mega Menu contains eight repeated card containers with the same row, 15px gap, 15px padding and 15px border radius; strong shared-class candidate.
Footer root uses grid with five 1fr columns and width=100vw; strong on desktop, needs 100%/overflow review and responsive evidence.
